summary: Describes private SIP extensions that let a network of trusted servers assert the identity of authenticated users, including the P-Asserted-Identity header, and applies existing privacy mechanisms. It works only inside a domain with agreed policies and is not a general identity solution. It was later updated by RFCs 5876 and 8217.

eli5.summary: Inside a trusted club, the doorman can write your verified name on a badge. This lets phone servers in a trusted network mark calls with who made them, without announcing it everywhere.

questions: how do trusted sip networks assert identity
